description: Read up to 20 upcoming appointment windows for a business, without sign-in. Returns businessId, slots, source_type and data_coverage; each slot has id, offeringId, title, startsAt, endsAt, freshness and data_age_seconds. Slots require a non-listed plan, the requested surface enabled, BILLING_ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED=true and STRIPE_MODE=test/live; only connected booking data within its freshness window is served; past or stale windows are omitted. An empty list does not mean no availability. This call reserves nothing and takes no payment.
name: get_open_slots
title: Get open appointment slots
